changelog: **Native push for the mobile app (#2775):** a new message now reaches the Android app while it is closed, and a tap opens the native thread in the right product. Delivery goes through the Expo push service with plain `fetch` (`src/lib/expoPush.ts`, rules in `src/lib/expoPushRules.ts`: batches of 100, `DeviceNotRegistered` deletes the row, other ticket/receipt errors count towards the same 5-strike ceiling as web push, never throws). `sendPushToUser` fans one payload and one category check out to browsers **and** app installs; native push needs no VAPID keys, so `sendNewMessagePush` no longer bails out without them. New model `NativePushToken` keyed by `(token, host)` — one phone, one Expo token, two products — and `POST/DELETE /api/push/native` (session required; the host is the one the request arrived on). A launch-time `refresh` never re-creates a row, so a device revoked on /account stays revoked until the next sign-in. Session revocation (`revokeAllTrustedDevices` / `revokeTrustedDevicesForUsers`) drops the account's tokens; the push retention rule now covers them too. /account lists app installs next to browsers. Optional `EXPO_ACCESS_TOKEN`. Design: `docs/mobile-push.md`.

en: The Android app now notifies you of new messages even when it is closed. Tap the notification to open the conversation — in the right product, if you use both. Signing out of one product stops its notifications only, and you can see and revoke the app under Account settings → Devices receiving push notifications.
tr: Android uygulaması artık kapalıyken bile yeni mesajları bildiriyor. Bildirime dokununca sohbet açılıyor — iki ürünü de kullanıyorsan doğru üründe. Bir üründen çıkış yapmak yalnızca o ürünün bildirimlerini durdurur; uygulamayı Hesap ayarları → Anlık bildirim alan cihazlar altında görüp kaldırabilirsin.
de: Die Android-App benachrichtigt dich jetzt auch bei geschlossener App über neue Nachrichten. Ein Tipp auf die Benachrichtigung öffnet das Gespräch — im richtigen Produkt, wenn du beide nutzt. Die Abmeldung von einem Produkt beendet nur dessen Benachrichtigungen, und unter Kontoeinstellungen → Geräte, die Push-Benachrichtigungen erhalten, kannst du die App sehen und widerrufen.
